subject: refactor(lodash): compact (algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js#689)
bodyLines: I added tests for this function, but none of the existing real tests test that compact is needed. I'm not too sure if it really is needed in the first place.
I left it for backwards-compatibility, but all tests pass with identity instead of compact
* refactor(compact): use Boolean instead of identity filter
